decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to win the game. It uses cheap cantrips like Opt and Impulse to dig for the combo pieces while also disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Counterspell and Foil. The deck also includes bounce spells like Chain of Vapor and Thwart for additional disruption. The main strategy is to control the game with counterspells and stifle effects while setting up the game-winning combo.

This deck focuses on utilizing enchantments to create a powerful combo, with the main strategy revolving around bringing back enchantments from the graveyard with Replenish and using Opalescence to turn them into creature threats. The deck includes various enchantment synergies and card draw engines to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently. By utilizing Enchantress effects to generate card advantage and ramping mana with Serra's Sanctum and Wild Growth, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a board full of enchanted threats.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the Enchantress engine by playing enchantments such as Enchantress's Presence and Sterling Grove to draw cards and generate mana. Once the engine is online, the deck can win by either creating a large army of creatures with Opalescence or locking down the opponent's board with Parallax Wave. The deck also has tools like Solitary Confinement and Seal of Cleansing to protect itself and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to quickly establish board control and overwhelm the opponent with its enchantment synergy.

The main focus of this deck is to establish and maintain a lock on the game by repeatedly casting and untapping Stasis, preventing opponents from untapping their permanents and effectively shutting them down. This is achieved by utilizing cards such as Portent, Chain of Vapor, and Gush to find key pieces like Stasis and Forsaken City, while also employing counterspells like Counterspell and Daze to protect the combo. Additional disruption comes from Black Vise and Root Maze, while Flash of Insight and Mana Short provide extra utility in maintaining the control and advantage.

The main idea of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent by consistently playing efficient creatures like Hypnotic Specter and Nantuko Shade, while disrupting their hand and board presence with cards like Duress and Cabal Therapy. The deck also includes removal spells like Smother and Diabolic Edict to deal with opposing threats. The deck aims to close out games quickly by attacking with evasive creatures and using cards like Cursed Scroll for additional reach. It also incorporates some card advantage engines like Graveborn Muse to maintain momentum throughout the game.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling and protecting the Phyrexian Dreadnought combo with Stifle, counterspells, and card draw. It aims to disrupt opponents with counterspells and Stifle while digging for pieces of the combo with card draw spells like Opt and Gush. The inclusion of Flash of Insight can help find necessary combo pieces in a pinch. The deck also includes some additional disruption with Misdirection, Thwart, and Chain of Vapor. Island is the primary land choice to support the deck's mana requirements.

The main focus of this deck is to use aggressive tactics combined with land destruction to disrupt your opponent's mana base and overwhelm them with powerful creatures. By utilizing cards like Wasteland, Rishadan Port, and Armageddon, you can keep your opponent resource-starved while quickly deploying threats like Terravore and Nimble Mongoose. The deck also features card draw with Sylvan Library and creature generation with Call of the Herd, allowing you to maintain pressure on your opponent. With this deck, you aim to quickly establish dominance on the battlefield and close out the game before your opponent can recover.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana and disrupt the opponent's resources, while also putting pressure on them with aggressive creatures like Terravore and Nimble Mongoose. The inclusion of cards like Armageddon and Wasteland helps to maintain board control by destroying the opponent's lands. Additionally, the deck has some versatility with cards like Naturalize and Disenchant for removal, and Sylvan Library for card advantage. Overall, the strategy revolves around quickly overwhelming the opponent while disrupting their game plan with land destruction.

The main concept of this deck is to build a powerful engine through enchantments, utilizing cards like Enchantress's Presence and Argothian Enchantress to draw cards each time you cast an enchantment. This combo-focused deck aims to control the board with cards such as Swords to Plowshares and Seal of Cleansing while ramping up mana with cards like Wild Growth and Exploration. In addition, the deck includes cards like Solitary Confinement and Sterling Grove to protect key pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of card draw, mana ramp, and board control.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disrupt their hand and board with discard spells like Duress and Cabal Therapy. The deck also includes removal spells like Smother and Diabolic Edict to deal with threats on the opponent's side. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Cursed Scroll and Graveborn Muse to maintain card advantage and finish off the opponent quickly with creatures like Hypnotic Specter and Nantuko Shade. The deck also includes resource denial with Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to use the Stiflenought combo to quickly win the game. By playing Phyrexian Dreadnought and then using Stifle to counter the sacrifice ability, the player can get a powerful 12/12 creature for just one mana. The rest of the deck includes counterspells and card draw to protect the combo and find the necessary pieces. This deck aims to be efficient and fast, effectively disrupting and overwhelming the opponent before they have a chance to respond.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal spells, and the card advantage generated from Standstill. By using land denial with cards like Dust Bowl and Mishra's Factory, along with powerful board wipes like Wrath of God, the deck aims to stall the game until it can establish a dominating position. The inclusion of Faerie Conclave and Mishra's Factory as creature lands provides a win condition while Humility can neuter opponents' threats. Overall, the deck aims to outlast opponents through efficient resource management and strategic decision-making.

This deck aims to control the game through a combination of land destruction, mana denial, and creature removal, allowing the player to slow down their opponent while building up their own board presence. The key strategy revolves around utilizing Oath of Druids to cheat powerful creatures into play, such as Terravore, while utilizing cards like Swords to Plowshares and Naturalize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a balance of control elements and threats, this deck aims to outmaneuver and overpower the opponent in a Pre-Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck revolves around utilizing Enchantress creatures and effects to draw cards and generate mana while controlling the board with enchantments like Parallax Wave and Sterling Grove. The key strategy is to quickly assemble a combo involving Opalescence, Serra's Sanctum, and Replenish to overwhelm the opponent with a massive board presence of enchantments. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Seal of Cleansing and Aura of Silence, while utilizing efficient removal options like Swords to Plowshares. Additionally, the deck includes powerful enchantments like Mirri's Guile and Solitary Confinement to further support the combo strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent by using a combination of burn spells and efficient creatures, maximizing the effectiveness of each card played. By applying pressure early on and maintaining a steady stream of damage, the deck aims to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Price of Progress and Sulfuric Vortex further adds to the deck's aggressive strategy, punishing opponents for playing non-basic lands and denying them life gain opportunities.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards using Madness and Threshold mechanics, allowing for powerful plays with cards like Arrogant Wurm and Roar of the Wurm. The deck is focused on aggressive strategies, using creatures like Wild Mongrel and Basking Rootwalla to apply pressure early in the game. Circular Logic and Daze provide some control options, while cards like Deep Analysis and Frantic Search help with card advantage. The deck also includes Wonder to provide evasion for creatures.
